dek: Thirty-eight landlords of subdivided units (SDUs), who contravened Part IVA of the Landlord and Tenant (Consolidation) Ordinance (Cap. 7) (the Ordinance), pleaded guilty and were fined between $700 and $22,400, amounting to a total of $135,100, on August 7, August 14 and today (August 21) at the Eastern Magistrates' Co
